blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Small businesses may seek an exemption from wage increase orders, the Department of Labor and Employment (Dole) said Tuesday, Sept. 29. According to Dole, small retail or service establishments with fewer than 10 workers or those affected by “natural calamities or human-induced disasters” may apply for a wage hike exemption. Employers may apply within 75 days from the effectivity of the wage order. Their application and other necessary requirements must be submitted to the concerned Regional Wage Boards in their respective regional offices within that period, the agency said.
